coverage_override.reason: The once-per-turn return effect and banishment-triggered self-Set effect are the two printed effects; their limit sentences are attached conditions.

effects.printed_clause: Once per turn: You can target up to 2 of your banished "Arckcestial" cards; return them to the GY.
effects.lua_implementation: A Spell Zone Ignition Effect targets one or two face-up banished Arckcestial cards and returns the still-related targets to the GY with REASON_EFFECT+REASON_RETURN.

official_references.matched_structure: Official banished-card recovery targets a banished card and returns it to the GY with Duel.SendtoGrave and REASON_RETURN.

effects.printed_clause: If this card is banished by the effect of an "Arckcestial" card: You can Set this card. You can only use this effect once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: The delayed EVENT_REMOVE trigger now requires this card's REASON_EFFECT and an Arckcestial reason-effect handler, then Sets itself if still related and Settable under its HOPT code.

official_references.matched_structure: Official movement triggers validate effect provenance with Card.IsReason(REASON_EFFECT) before performing their recovery action.

effects.issue: Confirmed and corrected: checking only re and its handler also accepted banishment paid as an Arckcestial activation cost. The trigger now requires REASON_EFFECT.
